item.title: Bulletin updated at 19:50 HKT 07/Dec/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon now affecting the coast of Guangdong will be gradually replaced by a relatively humid easterly airstream in the next couple of days. It will be cloudier and warmer with a few rain patches over the region during the weekend and early next week. A replenishment of the northeast monsoon is expected to affect southern China midweek next week. It will be brighter over the region in the latter part of next week.
